0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-7, on a six-game losing streak and 0-3 on the road) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (6-3, on a two-game winning streak and 3-1 at home), who sit third in the Northwest, one game back. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), Joan Beringer (fracture), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Utah lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 147-111 defeat in Minneapolis on March 18.
